blurb: Guests can book full-day, half-day, inshore, and offshore fishing trips targeting species like striped bass, bluefish, fluke, and offshore big game fish. Whale watching trips are private and include refreshments such as coffee, danish, lobster roll, champagne, and shrimp cocktail. The boat used is the Tomahawk 3, a 35' Carolina Classic.
